sample_raw_text: 125 ml any milk of your choice
1 tablespoon low- sodium soy sauce or tamari
2 baby pak choi, halved and sliced
130 frozen peas or or sprouted green peas (see Pro Tip)
3 maris piper potatoes, peeled and chopped
4 cm (1½in) knob of fresh root ginger, peeled and finely chopped
2 cm piece fresh ginger root, grated or finely chopped
1 Fuji or Gala apple, cored and coarsely chopped
1 small bunch roughly chopped Italian parsley, both leaves and tender stems
1 small jicama peeled and sliced into matchsticks
